subject: health
concept: Understanding empathy: recognizing and caring about how someone else might be feeling
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Compassion Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described situation to how the person involved might be feeling
exercise.abstract: Student explains what empathy means and describes a time they showed it or someone showed it to them

misconception_flags: confuses empathy with simply agreeing with someone, missing the emotional-understanding aspect

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
